text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社は、内部格付手法の使用を開始した日(先進的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社が基礎的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けた日後に先進的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けた場合にあっては、基礎的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けて基礎的内部格付手法の使用を開始した日。以下この項において同じ。)から二年を経過する日までの間は、次の各号に掲げる期間において、標準的な手法により算出した所要自己資本の額に当該各号に定める率を乗じて得た額が承認を受けた計算方法により算出した所要自己資本の額を上回る場合には、当該乗じて得た額から当該承認を受けた計算方法により算出した所要自己資本の額を控除した額に十二・五を乗じて得た額を第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式の分母に加えるものとする。一内部格付手法の使用を開始した日以後一年間九十パーセント二前号に掲げる期間を経過した日以後一年間八十パーセント
text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies adopting the internal ratings-based approach, during the period until two years have elapsed from the date of commencement of use of the internal ratings-based approach (in cases where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach received approval as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach after receiving approval as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach, the date of commencement of use of the foundation internal ratings-based approach after receiving approval as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph), shall, during the periods set forth in the following items, where the amount obtained by multiplying the required capital amount calculated using the standardized methods by the rate defined in each such item exceeds the required capital amount calculated using the approved calculation method, add to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1) the amount obtained by multiplying by 12.5 the amount obtained by deducting the required capital amount calculated using the approved calculation method from the amount obtained by such multiplication. (i) One year after the date of commencement of use of the internal ratings-based approach: 90%. (ii) One year after the expiration of the period set forth in the preceding item: 80%.

clauses_ja.text: 前項の規定にかかわらず、内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社は、内部格付手法の使用を開始した日(先進的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社が基礎的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けた日後に先進的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けた場合にあっては、基礎的内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社としての承認を受けて基礎的内部格付手法の使用を開始した日。以下この項において同じ。)から二年を経過する日までの間は、次の各号に掲げる期間において、標準的な手法により算出した所要自己資本の額に当該各号に定める率を乗じて得た額が承認を受けた計算方法により算出した所要自己資本の額を上回る場合には、
当該乗じて得た額から当該承認を受けた計算方法により算出した所要自己資本の額を控除した額に十二・五を乗じて得た額を第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式の分母に加えるものとする。
一内部格付手法の使用を開始した日以後一年間九十パーセント
二前号に掲げる期間を経過した日以後一年間八十パーセント

clauses_en.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies adopting the internal ratings-based approach, during the period until two years have elapsed from the date of commencement of use of the internal ratings-based approach (in cases where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach received approval as such after receiving approval as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach, the date of commencement of use of the foundation internal ratings-based approach after receiving such approval; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph), during the periods set forth in the following items, where the amount obtained by multiplying the required capital amount calculated using the standardized methods by the rate defined in each such item exceeds the required capital amount calculated using the approved calculation method,

shall add to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1) the amount obtained by multiplying by 12.5 the amount obtained by deducting the required capital amount calculated using the approved calculation method from the amount obtained by such multiplication.
(i) One year after the date of commencement of use of the internal ratings-based approach: 90%.
(ii) One year after the expiration of the period set forth in the preceding item: 80%.
